summary: Nora no longer has make_artifact or Smith: files leave through her computer (computer_export) and documents through document_publish, and her container no longer holds the host's Docker socket.
details: make_artifact, Smith (the per-job sandbox image), the Docker backend that launched it, the nora-compute network and its compute-egress proxy are removed, along with the R-45 nudge that only existed for make_artifact.
The nora service no longer mounts /var/run/docker.sock or joins the host docker group; a test reads docker-compose.yml and fails if either comes back.

Drop no longer mints per-job tokens (POST /api/tokens is gone, and so are DROP_JOB_TOKEN_SECRET and the pyjwt dependency). Drop's artifact read path, link shortener and POST/PATCH /api/artifacts are unchanged, so every old link keeps working.

The [compute] keys that configured the Docker backend (sandbox_image, job_timeout_seconds, max_concurrent_jobs, mem_limit, nano_cpus, data_host_root_env) are removed; only enabled and poll_tick_seconds remain.
Decision DEC-254 records the retirement (operator decision 4 of design/sandbox-runtime).
limitations: The compute-job outbox, its poller and the compute_jobs table are kept wired but idle as the delivery path for a future delegate_task; with no backend adapter, [compute] enabled = true builds nothing and logs a warning.
An artifact Smith made earlier still opens at its old link, but cannot be revised through computer_export.
